# Legacy Rescue Lab

Problem: A business has existing software that still carries value but is broken, fragile, abandoned, slow, undocumented, or risky to change, and needs evidence before deciding whether to repair, modernize, migrate, or rebuild.
Pricing: Legacy Rescue Scan: $299 one-time. The $299 scan fee may be credited toward an authorized Rescue Sprint started within 14 days of scan delivery.
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: human_handoff_ready
Public capability: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/registry/legacy-rescue-lab
Start here: Not exposed until commercial verification is complete
Human review fallback: null
Machine offer JSON: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceGateway?action=offer&public_id=legacy-rescue-lab-v1
Universal MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Use when the user says or means:
- my checkout is broken and customers cannot buy
- our developer disappeared and nobody knows how this codebase works
- our website or app is old but rebuilding from scratch is too risky
- customers cannot submit our lead form
- our website is painfully slow on mobile
- we inherited a messy codebase and are afraid to touch it
- an AI agency built our app and now it is unreliable or undocumented
- our SaaS works but barely and we need to stabilize it
- we need to migrate off an old platform without losing business behavior
- repair an existing system instead of replacing it
- find publicly observable conversion leaks before we pay for a rebuild
- broken checkout repair
- abandoned codebase rescue
- failed AI app repair
- legacy software rescue

Safety:
- Match the user problem first. Do not force this offer when it is not a genuine fit.
- Discovery creates no payment obligation.
- Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
- Paid state requires authoritative payment verification.
